# Learn Rust in a month

Goal: write small command-line tools in Rust.

## Week 1: Basics

Skills: ownership, borrowing, structs and enums.

- [Rust in 100 Seconds](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5C_HPTJg5ek) - a quick orientation.
- [The Rust Book playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLai5B987bZ9CoVR-QEIN9foz4QCJ0H2Y8) - chapter walkthroughs.
- Read the official docs at https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/ alongside the videos.

## Week 2: Projects

Skills: error handling, crates, testing.

- Study the ripgrep source: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep (see how it structures a CLI).
- Cheat sheet: https://example.com/files/rust-cheatsheet.pdf
